name: ars
description: Ars, a horseman of the apocalypse: a hooded skeletal reaper with a bare skull face and glowing cyan eyes, in a black hood, black spiked armour with bone-white trim and a long tattered black cloak that drapes over his mount's flanks, a great scythe with a dark wooden shaft and a long curved steel blade in his RIGHT bony hand on the screen-left side, the reins in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side, riding a skeletal bone-white horse with a horse skull, glowing cyan eyes, a black mane and spiked black barding
hands: the scythe stays in the reaper's right bony hand on the screen-left side and his left hand holds the reins on the screen-right side
